sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment, compensation, and Utah POST disciplinary records related to Christian C. Connelly.
Select a section to explore the supporting documents and recordings.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Christian C. Connelly began working for the American Fork Police Department on April 11, 2019. He resigned from the department on November 2, 2022, and began working for the Provo City Constable’s Office on November 29, 2022. On December 9, 2024, the POST Council voted to revoke his peace officer certification.

sections.title: POST Discipline
descriptions: According to the POST disciplinary proceedings, Christian C. Connelly recorded overtime on his timecard for a hearing after the prosecutor’s legal assistant told him he no longer needed to attend. He subsequently lied to the department multiple times about the overtime entries, including during a Garrity interview. The disciplinary allegations were lying under Garrity and falsification of government records.

Connelly resigned from the department on November 2, 2022, and began working for the Provo City Constable’s Office on November 29, 2022. On December 9, 2024, the POST Council voted to revoke his peace officer certification.
